sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Lightweight Ad-Monetized Mobile Games

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: primarily English common law, with residual French civil law and customary law influences derived from the former Anglo-French Condominium; statutory company and offshore legislation is modeled on English and BVI precedents.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: World Trade Organization (WTO) membership — Vanuatu accession effective 24 August 2012
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) — signed 14 June 2017, in force 13 December 2020

No comprehensive Double Taxation Agreements (DTAs) are currently in force for offshore International Companies; Vanuatu operates a nil-tax territorial structure for non-resident-owned International Companies

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2023 (AML/CFT Act 2023) read with the Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap 271]; International Companies Act [Cap 222], as amended, mandating beneficial-ownership disclosure to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); Companies Act No. 13 of 2015 (local companies UBO register); Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Guidance Notes and supervisory directives.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified notarized copy of the passport of each beneficial owner and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the beneficial owner's country of origin authenticating the passport issued by the relevant national passport authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — Vanuatu is NOT a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; the document must be notarized, authenticated by the origin country's competent ministry, and legalized by a Vanuatu High Commission or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the previous 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or banking institution in the beneficial owner's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarization followed by origin-country ministerial authentication and Vanuatu consular legalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original banker's reference letter confirming the identity, account history, and financial standing of the beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate banking institution maintaining the beneficial owner's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (bank letter notarized and then legalized through the Vanuatu consular channel)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional due-diligence reference letter backed by a certified certificate of good standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Chartered accountant firm or licensed attorney in the origin country

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, signatories, and ultimate beneficial owners against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Vanuatu domestic terrorist designations; Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) identification and enhanced due diligence (EDD) is required under the AML/CFT Act 2023, with 24-month risk-based client-file reviews and adverse-media checks performed by the licensed Vanuatu registered agent prior to incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Company Registry division, online name clearance and e-registration portal operated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] and the Companies Act No. 13 of 2015.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be written in Roman (Latin) script; Vanuatu's official languages are English, French, and Bislama, and the VFSC Registry requires the name in English or in a clearly pronounceable Latin-script transliteration; an International Company must carry the suffix 'Limited' or the abbreviation 'Ltd.' and must not imply that the entity is a domestic Vanuatu company, a licensed financial institution, or a governmental body.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank; Banking; Trust; Trustee; Insurance; Assurance; Reinsurance; Finance; Financial Services; Fiduciary; Credit Union; Savings and Loan; Deposit; Asset Management; Fund — each requires prior licensing approval from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap 257]
Government; National; Ministry; Authority; Police; Red Cross; University; Chamber of Commerce — each requires prior ministerial or Registrar approval
International (where the usage implies an intergovernmental organization or a status inconsistent with the International Companies Act)
Vanuatu (where the usage may mislead as to sovereign ownership or create a false association with the Republic of Vanuatu or any public body)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon issuance of a rejection notice by the VFSC Registry, the applicant, acting through its licensed registered agent, may within 14 calendar days file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies, stating the grounds of appeal and submitting supporting evidence (e.g., trademark certificates, consent letters, or proof of prior use) demonstrating that the proposed name is not confusing or misleading; the Registrar will issue a written determination within 21 days. Alternatively, the applicant may immediately deposit a new name application, and may apply in writing for a single extension of the reservation window, subject to payment of the applicable VFSC reservation fee, prior to the expiry of the initial 30-day window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A fully remote or virtual administrative office is accepted for the unlicensed ISIC 5820 hyper-casual mobile game publishing model; however, the International Company must at all times maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu through a licensed registered agent, which office is subject to statutory AML/CFT obligations, record-keeping requirements, and regulatory supervision. The game publisher's actual business operations and devops teams may lawfully remain hosted abroad.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: approximately 2% to 5% annualized likelihood of an unannounced physical on-site inspection for a low-risk, non-licensed International Company in the tax-exempt offshore tier, consistent with the VFSC risk-based supervisory framework (Banking_AML_Risk_Tier: Low_Risk_Standard).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory government tariff per VFSC consolidated fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation application fee (government registration duty)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory government tariff under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent and registered office arrangement (first-year service)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent / corporate services provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (USD 900–1,500 first-year flat fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of UBO passport, proof of address, and banker's reference
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in the origin country and Vanuatu High Commission / Consulate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for low-risk corporate due-diligence packages

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency reserve for name rejection appeal, name re-submission, or document re-legalization
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC Registry appeal filing fee and/or notary/consular authorities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory appeal tariff and market benchmark for re-legalization

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (Cap 222), as amended; sections 1–144, in particular ss. 5, 10–14 (registration) and ss. 36–38 (registered office and agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Form IC-01) submitted with the VFSC prescribed incorporation application
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; authorized capital is expressed in no-par-value shares; one issued share at par is sufficient; no escrow or capital deposit requirement applicable to International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) that the sole subscriber to the Memorandum of Association is confirmed as the first director of the Company; (2) that one hundred ordinary shares of no par value be allotted to the subscriber at par, fully paid, and share certificates issued; (3) that the registered office be fixed at the office of the Registered Agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the Registered Agent is authorized to accept service of process; (4) that the President, Company Secretary, and Treasurer be appointed as officers of the Company; and (5) that the banking mandate committee is established, with the President and Treasurer empowered to open and operate corporate bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC – Registry of Names, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed company names via the licensed registered agent to VFSC for availability and objection screening; names must not be identical or confusingly similar to existing entities and must not suggest a regulated banking, securities, or licensed activity unless authorized; written confirmation of name reservation is valid for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of passport of settlor or holding company directors
Due diligence questionnaire and source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused, file a written appeal to the VFSC Registry within 14 days or submit an alternative list of names for expedited re-screening.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (acting as pre-filing scrutineer)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the M&A in accordance with the International Companies Act; the sole subscriber executes the M&A before a notary public in Vanuatu or, if executed overseas, before a notary whose apostille or consular certification is attached; Articles must include permitted objects, share classes, and director powers consistent with the exempt company mandate.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Confirmation of no unlawful objects (gaming licensing certificate not required for software publishing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The agent will issue a correction memorandum listing any non-conforming clauses; re-execution is limited to the defective clauses and must be re-notarized within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VFSC Incorporation Submission and Statutory Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-01 together with the executed M&A, consent of the registered agent, and declaration of compliance; pay the official stamp duty and registration fee (USD 600 or equivalent in Vatu); the Registry issues a Certificate of Incorporation under the seal of the Commission upon satisfaction of section 14 requirements.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as registered agent (Form IC-02)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues an inquiry notice, the registered agent must file responses within 14 days; fees already paid are applied to the corrected submission, but a fresh application fee applies if the file is rejected for non-compliance with essential requirements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and First Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors in conjunction with registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the Certificate of Incorporation, the first director convenes an organizational meeting (physical or by written resolution) to adopt the first board resolutions: share allotment, registered office adoption, officer appointments, bank mandate, and adoption of the corporate seal; minutes and share certificates are entered into the statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Share certificate stubs and register of members
Register of directors, officers, and charges
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any defect in the board resolution is cured by unanimous written resolution executed by all directors; the rectified resolution is appended to the minutes with effect nunc pro tunc.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation Administrative Licenses and Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and municipal authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to VIPA for a Foreign Investment Registration Certificate (FIRC) if the company is 1% or more foreign-owned; obtain a general business license from the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue; open a corporate bank account with a commercial bank licensed by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu using the Certificate of Incorporation, FIRC, and board banking mandate.
required_dossiers: Passport copies and references of beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VIPA raises sector-related questions, the company files a written submission with the business plan and source-of-funds evidence; denial is appealable to the VIPA Review Committee within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) – general business licensing department; no industrial manufacturing license applicable to software publishing
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business License (Category: Professional and IT Services) under the Vanuatu Business License Act [Cap 259]

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu National Environment Service (under the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Schedule of Exempted Activities; registered under the EIA administrative register with a certificate of exemption (virtual publishing activity produces no physical discharge)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero point-source wastewater discharge from software operations; office premises must comply with the Waste Management Act No. 24 of 2008 for IT equipment e-waste; no VOC or stack-emission thresholds applicable; server hosting externally via cloud providers with ISO 14001 data center certification recommended.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate required for registered office premises from the Vanuatu Police Fire Service (annual inspection); structural load clearance not applicable to a non-industrial office tenancy; workplace safety clearance under the Employment Act No. 20 of 2010 requiring first-aid kit, emergency exit plan, and electrical safety inspection for any occupied physical office.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: vrca.gov.vu. Offshore company incorporation and annual licensing registry: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); official portal: vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity creates a Vanuatu International Company (IC) by engaging a VFSC-licensed registered agent, filing constitutive documents, and obtaining the Certificate of Incorporation. No tax-clearance certificate is required for incorporation. After incorporation, the IC is automatically classified as an offshore exempt company; no income-tax registration exists in Vanuatu. If the IC makes or intends to make taxable supplies in or into Vanuatu exceeding VUV 10,000,000 in any 12-month period, it must apply to VRCA for VAT registration. The application requires the certificate of incorporation, registered agent acceptance, statement of business activities (including hyper-casual game publishing and digital advertising), expected value and type of supplies in Vanuatu, and bank account details. VRCA issues a VAT Registration Certificate bearing a VAT identification number/TIN on a single common identification framework. Non-resident principals can sign documents by any lawful electronic or notarized signature acceptable to the registered agent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: a Vanuatu IC is a non-resident/exempt offshore company with separate legal personality and limited liability; it is not subject to Vanuatu income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax. It cannot elect pass-through treatment because no entity-level income tax regime exists; liability is not imputed to shareholders. For indirect-tax purposes, the IC is outside the normal Vanuatu VAT net except to the extent of taxable supplies connected with Vanuatu or imported services subject to reverse charge.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None comparable to check-the-box. Vanuatu has no entity classification election, no hybrid-mismatch election, and no transparent or partnership election for an International Company. The IC's exempt status is statutory and automatic. The only relevant election is voluntary VAT registration under the VAT Act for a person below the VUV 10,000,000 threshold, and the ability to apply for a different VAT accounting/tax year or input-credit allocation method with VRCA approval. Offshore status cannot be waived as a tax election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT — Value Added Tax under the Value Added Tax Act and Customs import VAT under the Customs and Excise Act; no GST or sales-and-use tax levy outside VAT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 10,000,000 of annual taxable supplies in or into Vanuatu (registration is compulsory once this threshold is met or exceeded in any 12 consecutive months); the imported-services reverse charge applies regardless of threshold when a Vanuatu IC receives services from a non-resident supplier that would have been taxable if supplied in Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control, pre-clearance e-invoicing API, or digital stamping mandate exists. VAT invoices must be issued within 28 days and contain the supplier's VAT number, recipient details, date, description, tax-exclusive amount, VAT amount, and total price. Customs export clearances use electronic single-window declarations (ASYCUDA World), but these are not linked to real-time VAT invoice clearance. Tax and invoice records must be retained for at least 7 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A registered IC may zero-rate exported goods if the goods are exported within 28 days after supply or import or within such longer period allowed by the Commissioner, and evidence of export is retained. Services are zero-rated when supplied to a recipient who carries on business outside Vanuatu and the services relate to business carried on outside Vanuatu, or the services are performed wholly outside Vanuatu and are not consumed or enjoyed in Vanuatu. Hyper-casual game publishing and ad-monetization services sold to non-resident platforms such as AdMob or AppLovin qualify for 0% VAT if the IC holds platform contracts, recipient tax-residency evidence, and payout data demonstrating offshore receipt and use. Input VAT attributable to such zero-rated export supplies is refundable; mixed-use inputs must be apportioned.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Customs Form) endorsed by VRCA Customs for any physical goods movement; for pure digital services, a digital-services export declaration or statement is substituted.
Bill of Lading or House Air Waybill for physical exports; for hyper-casual digital services, a signed platform agreement with AdMob or AppLovin and a service completion report.
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of export proceeds in foreign currency from the offshore payer.
AdMob and AppLovin payout statements and transaction logs showing monetization revenue, app identifier, date, and settlement currency.
Zero-rated VAT invoice with prescribed particulars and a statement of export or offshore service provision.
General ledger extraction for the IC's digital advertising export income and input VAT apportionment.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCA may audit zero-rated export claims and issue a revised assessment, clawing back any incorrectly claimed zero rating and disallowed input VAT credits. For careless or deliberate misstatement, the VAT Act authorizes civil penalties up to 200% of the tax avoided, default interest computed monthly, and prosecution of directors or the registered agent for offences. Knowingly false export declarations may attract fines and imprisonment of up to 12 months or two years, and the IC may lose its VFSC compliance certificate. The limitation period for a revised assessment is generally 5 years, extended without restriction in cases of fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a substantially liberalised currency regime. The Vatu is managed against a multi-currency basket but is freely quotable against USD, AUD, NZD, EUR and GBP. Current account convertibility is unrestricted: international companies may receive foreign currency revenue from gaming platforms and remit royalties, service fees and dividends without prior RBV approval. Capital account treatment is also open for a Vanuatu International Company: non-resident shareholders may inject equity or shareholder loans, and the proceeds may be held in offshore currency accounts. The practical remittance hurdle is not exchange control approval but bank-level source-of-funds scrutiny and documentary verification. No tax clearance certificate or profit remittance permit is required for an International Company that has no Vanuatu-source income and that has maintained its exempt status.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio. An International Company may retain export or service revenues in USD, EUR, AUD or any other freely usable currency in RBV-licensed banks or approved offshore accounts. There is no statutory timeline for conversion and no requirement to repatriate hard currency into Vatu. The receiving bank must report inward remittances for balance-of-payments statistics to the RBV, and the treasury should adopt an internal policy of converting Vatu balances only when operational local disbursements require VUV.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low as the sole primary treasury account; Medium as a supporting outbound disbursement rail. An offshore digital EMI without an RBV banking licence may not hold statutory capital escrow, may not issue VUV-account servicing for a Vanuatu entity, and cannot provide the full audit trail required for a capital injection. Cross-border EMIs such as Airwallex, Currencycloud or multi-currency B2B platforms may be used only for non-VUV operational payouts after the primary account is established with an RBV-licensed bank. Legal constraints include Financial Institutions Act licensing, the prohibition on deposit taking without a licence, and the need to ensure the EMI does not create an unauthorized Vanuatu permanent establishment.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Vanuatu International Company engaged in low-risk hyper-casual gaming, most tier-1 banks permit remote onboarding where the beneficial owners and directors provide certified passports, a licensed registered agent certificate, board resolutions, and source-of-wealth evidence. At least one director or a verified authorized signatory with an employment relationship to the ultimate parent is generally required to complete a live video KYC interview. A physical visit to Port Vila may be required if the corporate structure contains opaque trust layers, no audited parent, or beneficial owners residing in non-FATF-compliant jurisdictions. The registered agent should pre-clear the KYC file with the bank's compliance team before submission to reduce interview friction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu International Company with no economic substance, offshore nominee officers, or unexplained ownership layers in low-disclosure jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent certification of current corporate status; economic substance narrative for the hyper-casual publishing model; group structure chart showing ultimate beneficial owners; board resolution appointing signatories; CRS and FATCA classification forms; passport copies and professional references for all 25% or more beneficial owners; three years of group financial statements or an audited parent accounts file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Fragmented digital advertising receipts from numerous global payment service providers and ad networks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed contracts with Google AdMob and AppLovin; monthly payout statements; dashboard analytics reconciliation report; treasury ledger mapping each wire to game application and campaign; explanations of customer conversion funnel; transaction monitoring policy showing no cash or high-risk virtual asset channels.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound capital injection from a non-resident shareholder shortly after incorporation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Share subscription agreement; board resolution approving the capital increase; updated register of members; source-of-funds evidence comprising bank reference, wealth statement and three months of shareholder bank statements; legalised passport copies; statement that no third-party lending or crypto conversion was used.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound disbursements to contractors, software vendors and UA agencies in multiple currency zones.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed service agreements; itemised invoices; proof-of-delivery or campaign performance reports; contractor beneficial-owner identification where required; sanctions and adverse-media screening results; payment instruction tied to the corresponding SWIFT MT103 field 70 for audit reconstruction.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound wiring requires the shareholder to remit SWIFT MT103 from a regulated bank account in the shareholder's name to the dedicated Capital Escrow Account at an RBV-licensed tier-1 bank. The purpose narrative must clearly state 'Equity capital subscription into Vanuatu International Company' and include, where the correspondent bank requires it, an ISO 20022 purpose code corresponding to direct investment, such as G300 for establishment or equity capital, and the Vanuatu balance-of-payments statistical classification for inward share capital. The receiving bank must receive the corporate due-diligence file, board resolution authorising the capital increase, updated register of members, and source-of-funds evidence. The treasury should ensure the remitter name, the share subscription agreement and the SWIFT sender line are identical; no third-party deposit, cash, crypto or unexecuted loan agreement will be accepted. For shareholder loans, a signed loan agreement with commercial terms, an RBV-compliant purpose narrative, and a board treasury policy must accompany the wire.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rail for outbound trade and operational payments is SWIFT MT103 bank-to-bank priority transfer for vendor payments, platform service fees, group royalties and user-acquisition agency disbursements. A Commercial Letter of Credit is permissible only where a software platform or media-buying counterparty insists on documentary settlement; because hyper-casual gaming is a service model, the preferred rail remains MT103 with full audit fields. Escrow-style disbursement instructions should be executed only through the tier-1 bank's electronic banking portal with dual authorisation. Trade settlement documents, monthly payout reports, invoices and board-approved treasury limits must be retained to support every outbound transfer. For smaller recurring payments, domestic VUV direct debit or local EFTPOS may be used only for incidental Vanuatu expenses; all foreign advertisements, SDK licences and platform revenue-sharing fees should settle via MT103 to preserve transparency.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV vanilla deliverable forwards with an RBV-licensed commercial bank, executed under documented ISDA or master FX terms
USD/VUV non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with an offshore banking counterparty where physical settlement in Vuvatu is not operationally feasible
USD/VUV FX swaps and cross-currency swaps used for same-day treasury liquidity matching, subject to the bank's mark-to-market collateral policy
Spot FX contracts through authorised dealers for conversion of AdMob and AppLovin net revenue into VUV, AUD, EUR or other functional settlement currencies

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Levy Payment / Exempt Status Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of registration; payment is effected through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of approx. USD 25 applies after 14 days; continued non-payment for 90 days may result in administrative strike-off under the International Companies Act.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days after the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deliver may trigger agent resignation notice; if the company is left without a registered agent for 60 days, the Registrar may strike it off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for Vanuatu International Companies regardless of turnover or balance-sheet size; VFSC may order an audit only on specific regulatory cause.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is imposed for International Companies; IFRS is accepted if accounts are prepared voluntarily for management, banking, or administrative purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public UBO filing is required. The registered agent must maintain and update the register of members and beneficial owners, record share transfers promptly, and provide an annual confirmation to VFSC that ownership and UBO records are current and complete.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700 – USD 1,200 for registered agent and registered office; additional USD 300 – USD 600 for professional corporate secretarial support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not mandatory; voluntary review or audit typically USD 2,000 – USD 5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The International Companies Act (Cap 222) of Vanuatu statutorily exempts an International Company (VU_IC) from every form of Vanuatu direct taxation: corporate income tax, dividend withholding tax, interest withholding tax, royalty withholding tax, capital gains tax, and stamp duty on share transfers. No declining-rate incentives or tax holidays are issued because the effective tax rate is already nil. The only recurring sovereignty cost is the annual VFSC government fee payable through the licensed registered agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Vanuatu corporate income tax return exists. The single recurring compliance instrument is the VFSC Annual Return / Compliance Declaration under the International Companies Act (Cap 222), submitted in electronic form by the licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within one calendar month immediately following each anniversary of the date of incorporation. The registered agent must procure the signed declaration and pay the annual government fee before the statutory deadline; a foreign beneficial owner may sign electronically or by power of attorney appointing the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part A Box 1 - Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the International Company as shown on the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, followed by the unique IC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact English transliteration of the name; no local-language characters are accepted. The non-resident shareholder does not file this form directly; the agent files on the IC's behalf.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part A Box 2 - Registered Office in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The statutory registered office address, which must be the address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila or Luganville.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident IC cannot maintain a standalone local office; the registered agent's address is the legal seat of service of process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The licensed VFSC registered agent certifies that the company has complied with the Act during the preceding year, including maintenance of the register of directors and register of charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No non-resident certificate is required; the agent's wet or digital signature universally binds the offshore company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part C - Directors and Secretary Schedule
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current directors and the corporate secretary, including any changes during the year, with date of appointment and residential addresses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Natural-person directors may be non-residents of Vanuatu; corporate directors are prohibited for International Companies; no local director, employee, or travel day count is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part D - Shareholders and Share Capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Class of shares, number of issued shares, consideration received, and the beneficial owner schedule annexed to the declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Shareholders may be 100% non-resident; bearer shares are prohibited and every beneficial owner must be identified to the registered agent for the AML/KYC file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part E - Beneficial Ownership and AML/KYC Confirmation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the company maintains adequate, accurate, and current beneficial ownership information and that no politically exposed person or sanctioned party holds an interest.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The ultimate human owner's government-issued ID, proof of address, and source of funds must be on file with the agent, not with the VFSC public registry.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation whether the IC carries on a relevant activity, including intellectual property business or distribution and service centre business, in the preceding accounting period, and if yes, the substance details in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A hyper-casual game publisher monetizing via AdMob and AppLovin must declare IP business where the mobile game intangible is owned by the IC; claiming 'pure holding' is fatal if active exploitation occurs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part G - Signature and Truthfulness Warranty
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of at least one director or the corporate secretary warranting the truth of the declaration and notification of any charge created over the IC's assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign directors may sign remotely; a false declaration knowingly made is a criminal offence punishable by fine and imprisonment and can void the IC's tax-exempt status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing exposes the IC to (i) a VFSC administrative late fee and surcharge on the unpaid annual government fee, (ii) a default fine up to VUV 100,000 against the company and every officer in default under the International Companies Act (Cap 222), and (iii) administrative strike-off and deregistration after continued default, followed by costly restoration proceedings. A false annual declaration additionally exposes directors to criminal prosecution, cancellation of the IC's zero-tax status, and loss of the corporate veil.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions paid by an International Company to its non-resident shareholders; a distribution out of an IC's profits may be remitted free of any Vanuatu tax, stamp duty, or exchange control.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement network; therefore treaty relief is not available and not required. The IC relies solely on the statutory IC Act exemption. For banking and foreign platform (AdMob/AppLovin) account openings, the registered agent issues a Certificate of Good Standing and, where strictly required, the VFSC or the Ministry of Finance may issue a Tax Residence Confirmation; such document merely evidences the company's status in Vanuatu and does not create foreign law treaty benefits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding applies to outbound royalties and interest paid by the IC to non-resident licensors, lenders, or game developers. Royalties for game software sub-licenses and interest on intercompany loans flow to foreign beneficiaries free of Vanuatu withholding tax. As Vanuatu has no DTA network, no treaty rates modify the zero statutory rate.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A in VUV — Vanuatu has not enacted transfer pricing legislation and imposes no Local File or Master File threshold for International Companies. However, consolidated groups must respect arm's length pricing when contracting the Vanuatu IC with foreign related parties, such as a payable for publishing services or a royalty for game IP, because the ultimate parent's tax authority will apply its own CFC and transfer pricing rules; maintain contemporaneous pricing files in USD covering the IC's intercompany agreements.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's Economic Substance (Implementation) Act applies to International Companies carrying on relevant activities. For a hyper-casual games publisher, any of the following constitutes a relevant activity: (i) intellectual property business where the IC owns or exploits the game's copyright, trademark, or software for income; (ii) distribution and service centres supporting the ad-network contracts; or (iii) pure equity holding. The IC must report substance in its annual VFSC declaration and, where relevant, meet the 'adequate substance' test: a physical registered office or place of business in Vanuatu, permanent local employees with suitable qualifications conducting the core income-generating activity, and board meetings in Vanuatu with a local quorum. Game development, ad inventory management, and bank signatory authority carried out solely in foreign locations while booking income in the IC will breach the substance doctrine and expose the zero-tax status.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC owns the mobile game IP, executes AdMob/AppLovin monetization contracts, and collects licensing revenue, but declares 'pure equity holding' or 'no relevant activity' on Part F of the annual return while all economic decision-making, staff, servers, and overseas bank signatories are in a foreign jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines under the Economic Substance (Implementation) Act, administrative penalty per falsified declaration, disgorgement of the exempt status benefit, and deregistration of the IC by the VFSC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the beneficial owner who signed the false declaration face joint and several civil responsibility for unpaid foreign taxes assessed on the group, personal fines, a Court-imposed travel restriction pending prosecution, and imprisonment for the knowing false statement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through Sham Offshore Routing (Foreign CFC/PE Recharacterization)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the zero-rate IC as a letter-box to receive hyper-casual ad revenue while the actual business is managed and controlled in a high-tax jurisdiction, such as China, the United States, or the EU, without substance or arm's length reward, to avoid that jurisdiction's corporate income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu: cancellation of IC status, VFSC penalties, and potential strike-off. Foreign jurisdictions: recharacterization of the IC as a domestic resident or permanent establishment, inclusion of its profits in the parent's taxable base, fraud and negligence penalties of up to 100-200% of the avoidance, plus interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil will be pierced: directors and controlling shareholders are jointly and severally liable for the recaptured tax and penalties; in serious cases foreign courts issue travel bans, extradition requests, and custodial sentences for willful evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Obscuring the true beneficial owner of the IC, commingling personal and corporate AdMob proceeds, receiving crypto or fiat payouts from sanctioned ad networks, or concealing source-of-funds documentation from the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Regulatory fines and asset forfeiture under Vanuatu's AML/CFT legislation; VFSC suspension of the registered agent; bank account freezes by correspondent banks; the IC may also be delisted from AdMob or AppLovin payment rails for AML failure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the nominee shareholder are personally accountable for AML compliance failures and may be prohibited from acting as directors, subjected to confiscation orders over personal assets, and prosecuted criminally; travel bans are issued when flight risk is established.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Statement, Forgery, and Contempt of VFSC Notices
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Counterfeiting directors' signatures on the annual return, submitting forged economic substance declarations, refusing to answer VFSC information notices, or failing to notify the registered agent of a charge over the IC's gaming IP assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine not exceeding VUV 100,000 per offence and/or a term of imprisonment under the International Companies Act (Cap 222); the registration may be cancelled retroactively so the entity loses its limited liability and tax exemption from inception.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director or beneficial owner in default is personally liable for all debts of the company contracted during the period of invalidity, subject to restitution orders to the VFSC and aggrieved creditors, and may be barred from obtaining any future licence in Vanuatu.
